Headboard Add-On

Complete the look.

Lean back and relax with The Headboard Add-On.

Complete the simple, structural look of your Floyd Bed Frame with The Headboard Add-On. Assembly couldn’t be easier using steel supports that slide between the bed panels and attach to the headboard panel. The design offers a bit of give so that you can lean back and relax without questioning the support the headboard is there to give you.

Easy assembly.

With the addition of two steel brackets and a headboard panel, you'll be reading in bed in just minutes. Only a few parts, and no tools required.

Take apart-able.

It's easy to add on and easy to take off based on your needs or your set-up.

Quality materials.

Just like the Bed Frame, the Headboard is made with a real wood panel and steel supports.

With the addition of two steel brackets and a headboard panel, you'll be reading in bed in just minutes. Only a few parts, and no tools required.


• Designed to fit with The Floyd Bed Frame. 

• Assembly includes two (2) steel supports. 

• Upholstered Headboard Add-On available to purchase separately.

Panel 67” W x 18” H x 1.5” D 

Assembled Height 31.5" from top of headboard to floor

Assembled Angle 74° 


Package Details

Package 1 Headboard Brackets: 12” x 11” x 4.5” and weighs 8 lb.

Package 2 Headboard Panel: 73” x 23” x 2.5” and weighs 30 lb.

Panel 89” W x 18” H x 1.5” D 

Assembled Height 31.5" from top of Headboard to floor

Assembled Angle 74° 


Package Details

Package 1 Headboard Brackets: 12” x 11” x 4.5” and weighs 8 lb.

Package 2 Headboard Panel: 93” x 23” x 2.5” and weighs 37 lb.

Birch Plywood

Birch veneer and birch plywood with an engineered lightweight core. Our panels are TSCA Title VI certified to ensure extremely low adhesive emissions. It's a timeless material, used for its durability and strength. Because this is a real wood product, you may see variations in color and grain pattern.

 

Powder Coated Steel

The supports are made from powder coated steel. Each steel support is made from a series of 8 bends from a single piece of steel, which reduces waste in the production process.

US-sourced white oak veneer. A warm hardwood with beautiful texture and grain. Because this is a real wood product, you may see variations in color and grain pattern.

Our panels are TSCA Title VI certified to ensure extremely low adhesive emissions, and as the first in the world to use over 50% recycled material, our manufacturing partner is as committed to keeping furniture out of the landfill as we are.

 

Powder Coated Steel

Can the headboard be used with any size of the Bed Frame?

The headboard is available in two sizes: Queen and King. The King headboard is unfortunately not compatible when using a California King mattress. Additionally, with the current design, we are not able to offer a Twin headboard.

 

Is the headboard angled?

The headboard is angled back slightly (74° from the back of the Bed Frame). With your steel brackets placed 2” from the end of the panels though, this angling should not mean that the Bed takes up a larger footprint in your space.


Can I make my own headboard?

Definitely — you can purchase headboard hardware on its own to make a headboard (from the material of your choice!) for your Bed Frame.
